svg.text: Lower retrigger settings catch soft hits after loud ones,
until ringing or the zener tail plays a second note
Number: soft-after-loud pairs missed (second hit 1/2, 1/4 or 1/10 of the first, 35 to 110 ms later).
a single hit plays twice: unusable
As built: R1 1 MΩ, 1N4733A: missed out of 30 pairs
100 nF across the disc, R1 100 kΩ: missed out of 30 pairs
200 nF across the disc, R1 100 kΩ: missed out of 20 pairs
